facts.value: The Palafoxiana holds 45,000 items on more than 15,000 subjects, dated from the 17th to the 20th century, according to the Mexican culture ministry in 2019.

The books sit on cedar shelves in three levels, arranged by a scholastic view that places God as the base of all knowledge. The first level holds more than 11,000 Bibles and religious works, according to the Associated Press.

facts.value: Bishop Palafox never saw the project finished. The Associated Press says the library he founded in 1646 is the first public library in the Americas.
